scope: The 36 high-risk anchors discovered from the generated schema by R57. Migration-only candidates and opaque JSON remain outside this classification.

actions.delete_subject_row_by_auth_id: Delete the row only when the column equals the authenticated account UUID.
actions.delete_subject_row_by_verified_email: Delete the whole subject-owned row only after the account email has been independently verified and normalized by an approved rule.
actions.delete_participant_row_by_verified_email: Delete the participant-owned response row after participant identity verification, then invalidate or recompute affected aggregates.
actions.delete_participant_row_by_auth_id: Delete the authenticated participant's response row by account UUID, then invalidate or recompute affected aggregates.
actions.delete_membership_row_by_auth_id: Remove the access or role grant for the authenticated account UUID without deleting another person's content.
actions.delete_legacy_subject_row_by_auth_id_or_: Delete a legacy subject profile using the auth UUID first and a separately verified email fallback only where the schema proves both anchors belong to the same subject role.
actions.erase_with_selected_subject_row: Erase this value only as part of an already-authorized subject-row deletion. It is forbidden as an independent selector.
actions.redact_actor_attribution: Replace or remove actor attribution without deleting the shared record the actor created.
actions.pseudonymize_retained_audit_identity: Preserve only the minimum audit event required by an approved retention policy while irreversibly unlinking the account identity.
actions.redact_shared_record_role_bundle: Redact every identifier for one role in a shared record without silently deleting other participants' or the customer's record. The role bundle must be complete before execution.

standings.classified_implementation_unverified: The semantic action is classified, but live coverage and database behavior are not accepted.
standings.blocks_alternate_anchor_coverage: The row is subject-owned but the live path does not cover every authoritative legacy or anonymous anchor.
standings.blocks_participant_erasure_design: Participant verification, aggregate invalidation and linked-row traversal are not yet proved.
standings.blocks_shared_record_policy: Deleting the whole row could destroy another person's or customer's record; a complete redaction bundle is unresolved.
standings.blocks_retention_policy: Lawful purpose, duration, minimum retained fields and irreversible pseudonymization are not yet approved.
standings.blocks_schema_reconciliation: The generated type surface and migration or runtime expectation contradict one another.

requires: participant identity and aggregate invalidation design
approved audit purpose, field minimum and retention duration
database tests proving exact rows and collateral rows

not_authorized: using a phone number, name or unverified email as a global deletion selector
deleting shared workshop, referral or publication records because one actor requests erasure
treating a table mention as proof of alternate-anchor coverage
linked database access, migration execution, deployment, merge or release
